description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/62407785), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EA%B0%91%EC%9E%90%EA%B8%B0-%EC%97%84%EB%A7%88%EA%B0%80-%EB%90%98%EC%97%88%EC%8A%B5%EB%8B%88%EB%8B%A4/3643)

The request of the son from the previous life that appeared in front of the main character of the 3-po generation!  But right now I'm not in a position to have a child...  ?!  In front of 'Ha-gam', who has not been able to properly date because of being hit by life, 'Choi Jeong-sik', the son of the previous life, appears and asks him to give birth to him in this life.  Student loans, charter loans, new jobs…  Da-gam, who is not in a position to give birth to a child, tries to refuse Jeong-sik's request, but he suggests that Da-gam start dating.  However, the dating strategy of a 'dating fool' who has never had a proper relationship fails every time...  !  Will Dagam give birth to a formal relationship with a stable relationship?  Or will he make a completely different choice?!
